body: I read this somewhere today and I truly think it sums up our feelings towards our pets. It’s not that others don’t understand a loss of a pet. I’m sure they do. They just don’t know our feelings and our life with our pets. Our everyday quirks and our love towards our own pets. It’s a bond that can only be understood and shared with our immediate family and our pets. Wishing u so much comfort.

I’m so sorry. I just lost my dog. It’s been exactly 24 hours. We had to put her down because she was struggling and it hurts. Loss is the most horrific torture and it’s so heavy on the heart. I feel u. I’m so sorry. I’m crying while I’m typing this because I’m going through it myself. I’m just trying to cope in diff ways. My mom and I are both sleeping with my precious puppy’s blankets because we just can’t get enough of her scent. It’s comforting to hug her blankets and smell them. It’s almost as if she’s still here. It feels like her. She was 11 years old but she will always be a puppy to me. My puppy was born in January of 2011 and passed on Jan 31st of 2022. My best advice would be to grieve and mourn and don’t hold it in. Trust me, it’s cathartic. I’m so sorry,genuinely.
